scope: aggregate evidence integration for round-two R1.2; no manuscript or response edits
operational_definition: age-referenced, outcome-informed EHR-derived organ-state deviation with prognostic information

outcome_supervision.estimand_note: original matched ablation comparator; do not compare its delta-C magnitude directly with the new information-matched M baseline
outcome_supervision.supports: prospective supervision is the main source of downstream discrimination, with little change in chronological-age fit

recorded_burden.supports: association beyond the measured recorded-burden and healthcare-density covariates under the stated models
recorded_burden.does_not_establish: absence of unrecorded/subclinical disease or unmeasured healthcare-ascertainment effects; unexplained variation is not a percentage of biological aging

shared_output_structure.source_section: Shared and residual covariance patterns in the multi-organ OSAG profile
shared_output_structure.interpretation: dominant common model-output dimension; not seven independent aging clocks or an independently validated biological factor

panel_a.interpretation: organ-aligned prospective association, not complete organ independence

panel_c.interpretation: post-hoc output-label mapping negative control, not neural-query masking

organ_alignment.supports: preferential organ-aligned prognostic information within a highly shared profile
organ_alignment.limits: the model was supervised by organ outcomes; this is not independent molecular/tissue aging validation, complete organ independence or neural-query masking
